test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The photographer climb / the tree and took pictures / of the leopard / chasing its prey.
solution:
The segment that contains a grammatical error is **'****The photographer climb'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace** 'climb'** with **'climbed'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• add **"-ed"** to the verb **'climb'** to change it to the p
